mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO COMTNBBSMASTEROPTN (BBS_ID, ANSWER_AT, STSFDG_AT, FRST_REGISTER_ID, FRST_REGIST_PNTTM ) VALUES
( #{bbsId}, #{commentAt}, #{stsfdgAt}, #{frstRegisterId}, SYSDATE() )
mapper.select: SELECT a.BBS_ID, a.ANSWER_AT, a.STSFDG_AT, a.FRST_REGISTER_ID, b.USER_NM as FRST_REGISTER_NM, TO_CHAR(a.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as FRST_REGIST_PNTTM FROM COMTNBBSMASTEROPTN a LEFT OUTER JOIN COMVNUSERMASTER b ON a.FRST_REGISTER_ID = b.ESNTL_ID WHERE a.BBS_ID = #{bbsId}
mapper.update: UPDATE COMTNBBSMASTEROPTN SET ANSWER_AT = #{commentAt}, STSFDG_AT = #{stsfdgAt}, LAST_UPDUSR_ID = #{lastUpdusrId}, LAST_UPDT_PNTTM = SYSDATE() WHERE BBS_ID = #{bbsId}
